variants.prompt: REFORM LIGHTING/TIME: A sultry young woman lounges on a plush, white leather couch in a dimly lit, high-end nightclub. Neon lights from the bar and dance floor cast a rainbow of hues on her porcelain skin, accentuating the subtle contours of her face and the curves of her body. Her fitted, black leather jacket and distressed denim mini-skirt seem almost out of place in the chic, upscale setting. She leans back, one stiletto heel crossed over the other, her emerald green eyes half-lidded and inviting as she surveys the lively scene before her.
